title: ReLOAD: Real laboratories operated at a distance
reason: Describes the ReLOAD remote-laboratory system and reports students' opinions from online tick-box questionnaires and focus groups/interviews. No per-student usage indicator or lab-work product is related to outcomes or traits.

extraction.design: system description plus questionnaire and focus-group evaluation
extraction.notes: Over 50 students interviewed; questionnaire n not extracted.
